text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Mornin', Trainer! 
Can't wait for the festival, huh!

Once again this year, I traveled to Yukino 
Bijin's hometown 
to see Iwate's traditional festival: 
the "Chagu Chagu Umamusume."

The Chagu Chagu Umamusume is a traditional 
event where local 
Umamusume don kimonos and walk over a 
dozen kilometers. 
The two of us had been eagerly 
anticipating it, but—

text_block_list.name: Loud Male Voice
text_block_list.text: Heeeey!! Is Yukinko in there?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
N-No way! There's no way I could do 
that~... 
I told ya before, didn't I~...

text_block_list.name: Male Festival Staff
text_block_list.text:
The whole village's gonna be crushed, ya 
know! 
Yukino as a Chagu Chagu Umamusume... 
That's what all of us wanna see!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! But even if ya say so... 
The Chagu Chagu Umamusume is a festival 
to show appreciation for the local working 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I left this place to become a racer, so 
my situation's completely different. 
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Woman from the Market Street
text_block_list.text:
Now now, Yukinko, you're as fit for 
a Chagu Chagu Umamusume as can be! 
You'll look downright darlin' in your 
festival best~!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman with a Cane
text_block_list.text:
If you're wearin' a kimono, I'll dress ya 
up myself! 
Don't you worry about a single thing and 
just join in.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —Wait, j-jeje?!

Villagers came streaming into 
Yukino Bijin's family home one after 
another.
choice_data_list:
Everyone really wants you to take part, 
Yukino.

Everyone really wants you to take part, 
Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B-But...

text_block_list.name: Male Festival Staff
text_block_list.text:
True enough, Chagu Chagu Umamusume is 
meant to honor 
the Umamusume who work the farm fields. 
But listen—

text_block_list.name: Male Festival Staff
text_block_list.text:
At its heart, it's about givin' thanks to 
the Umamusume 
who share their lives with this village!

text_block_list.name: Female Festival Staff
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, do you have any idea how much 
you cheer this village up?! 
Pourin' your whole heart into racin' and 
helping out around town~...!

text_block_list.name: Male Festival Staff
text_block_list.text:
We just wanna show our gratitude to you, 
Yukinko! 
...Won't you accept how we feel?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...A-Aw, everyone...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep ya waitin'~. 
Never thought I'd be puttin' this outfit 
on again, though.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's different from the Shuntaisai, 
sure, 
but Chagu Chagu Umamusume also weaves 
together 
the bonds between humans and Umamusume. 
So—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to stand tall and proud in this 
outfit. 
—That's what I decided!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer! I might be clumsy, but 
I'll be in your care as my attendant!

In this festival, having an "attendant" 
walk alongside each 
Umamusume is essential. Their role is to 
support the Umamusume 
and ensure they don't trip while dressed 
in kimono.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want me, though?
Are you sure you want me, though?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't have it any other way, Trainer. 
Because—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
After all, you're the one who always 
has my back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Festival Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're getting started! 
Folks at the front, please start walking 
slowly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! It's starting! 
Let's give it our all, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Woooow! Yukiiiii-chan!" 
"Look over here! Over here!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Heeey! Don't you worry, 
I can see all of ya!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It's always been somethin' special! 
Folks come flockin' from all over the 
prefecture and beyond!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa, wait a second. Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that really brings me back to life! 
Who'd've thought there'd be a water 
station here!
choice_data_list: We've walked a ton, after all.
We've walked a ton, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Sure have! ...Still, we've got a long ways 
to go. 
There's so many people, I can't even see 
the end—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"You all look gorgeous!" 
"My, look how much you've grown!" 
"Honey, hurry and snap a picture of our 
girl!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. 
I really love this festival.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's smilin'—both humans and 
horsegirls alike... 
It's just bustin' at the seams with so 
much love!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
To our hometown that raised us up all this 
time, 
and to everyone who's looked out for us 
along the way—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm standin' tall with my chest held high, 
tellin' 'em, "Look how big I've gotten!"
choice_data_list: Yeah. Then let's keep walking, Yukino!
Yeah. Then let's keep walking, Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, sir!!

The day after the Chagu Chagu Umamusume 
festival ended, 
we were on the Shinkansen heading back to 
Tokyo.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um! Do we already have our trainin' 
all picked out for when we get back?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I can't wait to get back to 
Tracen! 
I've been practically itchin' to go since 
last night!
choice_data_list: It's for everyone back in Iwate, isn't it?
It's for everyone back in Iwate, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
! Wow, as expected of my Trainer! 
It's like you're an ESP-er or somethin'!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You know just about everythin'! 
And you were so helpful by my side, too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Gosh, absolutely! ...Hehe. 
I'm so glad I came here with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, goin' back home this time 
around... 
it touched my heart real deep...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So for our next trainin' session, 
I'm gonna push twice as hard as usual, 
b'gosh!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm just so eager to get trainin' again! 
I've been fidgiting nonstop since last 
night!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't fall asleep at aaall yesterday 
either! 
Man, it was quite a struggle!
